title.zh: 利率与债券 · 利率升为什么债价跌
title.en: Interest Rates & Bonds · Why Do Bond Prices Fall When Rates Rise

desc.zh: 债券是一串未来现金流，利率升了、折现重了，老债券就必须降价才卖得掉。
desc.en: A bond is a stream of future cash; when rates rise, discounting gets heavier, so an old bond must drop in price to sell.
